observations: Commercial-style blender with a clear plastic jar and black lid.
Brand 'GEMAT' is printed on the front control panel of the silver-colored base.
The control panel features two toggle switches and two rotary dials.
The blender is sitting on a retail box labeled 'Versatile Efficient Durable' showing the same product.
A '5 YEAR' sticker is visible on the side of the blender jar.
The setting appears to be a retail shop with other boxed kitchenware in the background.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the GEMAT brand name and a commercial-style design.
The design is consistent with heavy-duty blenders, but durability cannot be verified remotely.
Requires a video demonstration of the unit processing hard materials.

risks.risk: The motor may be non-functional or have worn brushes.
risks.proof: A video of the blender running through all speed settings.

risks.risk: The jar may have leaks at the blade assembly or hairline cracks.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the jar filled with water showing no leaks.

risks.risk: The blades may be blunt or the drive socket stripped.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the blades and the drive coupling on top of the base.

proof_requests: Video of the blender powered on and running at different speeds.
Photo of the rating plate on the bottom or back of the base to confirm power wattage.
Clear photo of the blades inside the jar.
Photo of the drive socket on the base where the jar connects.
response.reason: The brand and type are identified from the photos. It will be priced at its worst case as a non-functional unit until proof of operation is provided.
